'''0.18a''' is a major update for [[Survarium]] that added the [[Tarakanovsky Fort]] location and English localization. It signified the start of the Closed Beta for [[Teamplay]] and opened up access to international players.

==Changelog==
* Added a new location “[[Tarakanovsky Fort]]" 
* Added [[RGD-5]] grenades
* Using a faster torrent client and change the mechanism for applying patches
* Added English and Ukrainian localization
* Poisoning “thermometer" was removed from the interface
* When spawning the player is completely invulnerable. When you exit the base invulnerability decreases (total time: 4 seconds)
* Changed the base at the ATP area on the map “[[Rudnya]]”
* Changed the base on the map “[[School]]”
* Modified the base on the map “[[Chemical Plant]]”
* Introduced a new algorithm for selection of players in the match; Depending on the items worn by the character. High ELO rating can change this level of combat. For every minute spent in the queue waiting for a match the limits of permissible fights are constantly expanding. Now new players have much less chance of being in a match with fully equipped characters
* Changed the character jump animation
* Improved game performance on minimum settings
* Allies indicators now decrease in size with distance
* Temporarily disable all the perks of the character
* Temporarily disabled support for multiple characters on your account 
* Reduced rate of fire for [[Vityaz]] (from 750 to 700)
* Change cartridges 9x19. HP is now the patron base and does not give any bonuses. FMJ cartridge has a 10% bonus to penetration and a 10% penalty to the damage
* Changed the settings for shotguns to strengthen their close-range and weaken their long-range
* Removed buckshot from the game (12x70, 3/0)
* Reduced the bonus damage when hit in the head

===Bug fixes===
* Fixed a bug causing a crash associated with a large number of simultaneous sound playbacks
* Fixed a bug causing a crash while selling items
* Fixed a bug causing a crash during installation of trap
